steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: Come in.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: You're here, Golding.

steps.name: Golding
steps.text: Lettou... You know us better than I ever imagined.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: What do you mean?

steps.name: Golding
steps.text: The Londinium Self-Salvation Corps.

steps.name: Golding
steps.text: Where did you get this information from?

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: Does it matter?

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: Have a seat, Lady Golding. Please, there is no reason for you to feel anxious.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: This war is not between you and I.

steps.name: Golding
steps.text: Answer me, Lt. Colonel.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: I know why you came, Golding. You want to buy time.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: You are under the impression you have enough leverage to discuss terms. You think you can still help your friends.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: How regrettable. I thought you would be wiser.

steps.name: Golding
steps.text: We had a conversation not too long ago.

steps.name: Golding
steps.text: You said you did not want to see Londinium become the next Lingones.

steps.name: Golding
steps.text: Take a look around us. Take a look at the deep abyss that Londinium is plunging into.

steps.name: Golding
steps.text: Is this the choice you made for yourself that you spoke about?

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: Golding... Didn't you rebut me on that?

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: Correct, we are plunging toward that abyss. War has begun. War once tore apart Gaul, our homeland.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: What will it tear apart this time? Maybe it will be the Sarkaz. Maybe it'll be Victoria.

steps.name: Golding
steps.text: You know how disastrous this will be. Hundreds of thousands... Millions of people will—

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: Will bleed, die, and buried by this era.

steps.name: Golding
steps.text: You know that better than anyone!

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: That is correct. I know this very well, but I must also admit that it was you who opened my eyes. You made me reflect on my decision.

spans.text: That is correct. I know this very well, but I must also admit that it was you who opened my eyes.
made me reflect on my decision.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: If I had to question my conscience—

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: I would not have cared nearly as much.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: Let us cast aside those hypocritical high hopes of 'mankind' or 'civilization,' Golding.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: When we were young, we talked freely of these subjects and, with nothing but admiration in our hearts, sung the praises of the outstanding men and women in history.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: Mankind, the master of all things! Our intelligence and bravery set us apart from wild beasts and graced these lands with this radiant miracle!

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: But if we simply lifted our heads from the books and compare, we would realize how close their endings are to the reality before us.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: The same downfalls, the same rottennesses, the same self-destructions.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: What if all those things we sing the praises of were nothing but temporary illusions? What if believing that they are eternal makes us naive?

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: What if destruction was our true nature?

steps.name: Golding
steps.text: You weren't so pessimistic before, Lettou.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: Pessimistic.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: Golding, you are so kind with your choice of words. You described my crazed musings as just 'pessimistic.'

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: I thought I warranted harsher criticism.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: It seems... you are not as resolute as I thought you would be.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: I am simply... exhausted.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: I merely started to try facing reality. It is very painful, but I have no other choice.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: As for the conversation we had the other day, I can now offer you a new answer.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: I did not choose any missions for myself, Lady Golding.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: I only wanted to survive... the ceaseless destruction.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: It's pitiful and weak, insignificant and inadequate, but this is the answer I arrived at, and it is the only one I have to offer.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: What else can I do?

steps.name: Golding
steps.text: You're a soldier. You should've...!

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: Followed orders? Whose orders should I have followed? The King is dead, the Sarkaz run the parliament, and each duke has his own master plan.

steps.name: Golding
steps.text: You could have—

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: —become a hero?

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: At what cost?

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: What if the price... is not one that I can afford?

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: When you walked into the room, did you see the eyes of the guard standing by the door?

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: The officers under me, my comrades, and those bewildered young men... Till has five children, Sasan's mother has been paralyzed for three years, and Totten's brother has Oripathy.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: The vampires will suck their blood dry.

steps.name: Golding
steps.text: Bowing down will not prevent anything.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: At the very least... Nothing has happened yet, as of today.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: Golding, it's my hope that you survive this as well, speaking personally.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: Fundamentally, you and I might just be of a kind. It's only that I have chosen to give up, while you are still standing firm.

steps.name: Golding
steps.text: You and I are nothing alike.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: You asked me where I obtained the information on the Londinium Self-Salvation Corps.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: Very well, I shall answer you. From a cowardly teacher.

steps.name: Golding
steps.text: What are you saying...?

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: Look at yourself, Golding. Your blunders and the tracks you left behind are owed to your cowardice and fear.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: Sentimental kinds have never been a good fit for intelligence work. You've known that from the start.

steps.name: Golding
steps.text: No, it can't be!

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: There's been a lot of chatter on my communications here.

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: The Sarkaz ambushed... the Camden Borough safe house... We.... Their forces...

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: Alert... The safe house at Auchterigg...

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: Hello? Can anyone hear me? This is the Magna Borough safe house. We're under...

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: Golding, they are dying because of you.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: You pushed them into the fire.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: This is what your 'fight' brings.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: And for that, I can only mourn.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: There's too many men. They're well-equipped, and they're working far too well with each other.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Mercenaries aren't capable of this. These are military elites.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Each and every one of them is a bloodthirsty machine who dug his way out of a thousand battles.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Out of the way, the lot of ya!

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Indra, watch your back!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: This isn't going to work. We are on the back foot right now.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: I will locate the position of their commander. Amiya, maintain formation. Don't stop.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I-I got it!

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Damn, there's more of them down this alley!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Stay close, Doctor. We will cut our way through!

a.text: 'Go forward three hundred meters and take the first left.'

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Who's that?!

a.text: 'Hurry up. There are more ambushers on the roof.'

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, did you hear that? That voice...

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Watch out for their Arts! Cut through this danger zone!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Hold on tight, Doctor.

options: We have to give it a shot.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: I hate being ordered around! Tsk, fine!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Bloody... That's a wall there!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: No...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Some kind of illusion, perhaps? Charge through it!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: *pant*...*pant*....

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: There's no one I hate more than a sneaky bastard like you! Show yourself!

a.text: 'That assassin of yours has already taken down the commander of your pursuers. You are safe for the time being.'

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: I said, show yourself!

a.text: 'Her name is Ascalon, is it? Impressive.'

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, behind me.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Who are you?

a.text: 'Please, there is no need to fret, dear Rhodes Islanders. A few of my colleagues just touched base with Alexandrina not too long ago. Alas, it did not go too well.'

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: You are... the man behind Allerdale.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Show yourself.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I won't say it again.
Please lower your hammer, Your Highness. You are merely wasting your strength.
As heir to the throne—from a certain viewpoint, at least—you should have a bit more patience.
You said so yourself not too long ago. That we should have... a 'conversation.'

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: You had the Self-Salvation Corps tapped.
Their evacuation plan will be successful. Do note that this is a promise, not sarcasm.
My sincerest pleasure to meet all of you, ladies and gentlemen. I hope there yet remains room for our objectives to coexist.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: An ashen trilby...?
Very perceptive, Lady Isabelle Montague. I should have expected no less from a scion of the Count of Manchester. Indeed, we are often referred to as the 'Trilby Ashers.'
Should you have the chance, please send your mother my regards.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: You—

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Please, there is no need for alarm, Lady Montague. I harbor no ill will against you and your friends, at the moment.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Is the Arts gimmick you have over there a gesture of your goodwill, too?

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: I'm not fond of having conversations next to a pile of explosives.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: This is merely a precaution.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Well then, here's a precaution, too.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Lower your weapon, Miss Ascalon. This is not worth it.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Rhodes Island Pharmaceuticals, made a series of passage and call permit requests for so-called 'industrial waste recycling and processing' purposes, currently hiding within the territory of the Duke of Gododdin.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Currently six hundred and thirty-one kilometers away from Londinium.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And what if we are?

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Miss Amiya, I surmise your recycling work is proceeding apace?

options: Looks like the Victorian bigwigs aren't completely oblivious to us.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: We do merely what must be done.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: You have been very careful. You charted your course and built a well-hidden supply network around your ship. You wish to avoid Victoria's attention.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: And you almost fooled us.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Regardless of whether your intentions are good or otherwise, wouldn't you agree that discretion is the worst quality there is to a ruler?

options: Who do you serve, Mr. 'Trilby Asher?'

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: If at all possible, I would say that I serve Victoria.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Alas, the reality is that I serve only a small part of Victoria. This small part is more than enough to keep me well occupied, however.

options: Which means you work for one of the dukes.
If the Duke of Wellington saw us as a threat—
Rhodes Island would already have been attacked.
The Duke of Windermere's control has yet to reach Duke Gododdin's territory. Not by a long shot.
From what I know, the Duke of Normandy is more interested in business.
Most other dukes are fence sitters.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: 'Doctor,' the commander of Rhodes Island... There exists very little information on you. We were under the impression that this was due to a lack of importance.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: We will reevaluate our internal appraisal.

options: What is Rhodes Island worth to that 'part of Victoria' you speak of?

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: We actually do not have much of an interest in a so-called pharmaceutical company that deals in waste recycling.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: But your operator has a very unique background. Moreover, she possesses something important.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: You've failed once, but you still haven't given up.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: This is my job, Your Highness. Let us not make things harder for each other.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: This sword is nothing more than a heavy rod of iron in your hands.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: What do you intend to do with it? Can you really cut through the Catastrophe that looms above us?

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: It is a mere tale. You cannot wield it to its true potential.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: What does Duke of Caster want to do with it, then?

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: To fulfill a promise.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: A promise?

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: To bring her followers peace and safety.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: We do indeed have certain... technologies that can immediately put this blade to good use, just as the Sighs of Kings once sheltered Londinium.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: The Duke wishes for this blade to become a turning point for unity.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: In that case, those who aren't on your side will deservedly be swallowed by the Catastrophe.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: That is how it will become that turning point.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: (Doctor, I will make my move in three seconds. We must escape this situation.)

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: (Our operators on the landship are more than capable of taking care of the crisis that could soon unfold... and so we have to take this risk.)

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: (Three.)

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: (Two.)

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: (One.)
All of you seem pretty tense. Perhaps I came at a bad time?

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Right on time.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Ines.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Mr. 'Trilby Asher,' you have to admit that you came well-prepared.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Thirteen small communication stations, with four of them triggered passively. They were set up to automatically send out orders if they don't receive your message after ten minutes.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: I didn't want to venture a guess as to what orders they were meant to send out, so I took the liberty of crushing them all.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: I hope you don't mind.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Your subordinates were very strong, even after they heard the word Vampire.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: That said, I believe that aside from the Sarkaz Royal Court, there are certain others hiding in the city who would be very interested to learn of their existence.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Tell me, where do you suppose I should take them?

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Ines, former Sarkaz mercenary... It's hardly surprising that you are still alive. We've determined for some time now that someone was behind all these little tricks around Londinium.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: You've done very well.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: We know that there is a sizable number of Sarkaz mercenaries inclined to leave the Military Commission's control, but we both know that does not come without a cost, don't we?

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Your business partner... might be in fairly dire straits.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Perhaps we should be a little more blunt with each other.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: I know you have more tricks up your sleeve, and you know we still have some trump cards in our hand. Let's stop probing each other.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Your shadow tells me you are wavering.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Very well. Let's make a deal.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: I have a tricky mission, but as you can see, I am not much for fighting and adventure.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: So you want someone to die in your stead.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: I have faith in your abilities.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Certainly you have already seen the airship that is currently parked at the now-isolated Norport Borough.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Make your way there and get your hands on its schematics.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: You get to live. For now.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: You, your friends, your allies, your wounded, and your landship all get to remain alive for the time being.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: This is no trouble at all to Victoria, but as for the rest of you...
